gaps.term: limit of a nondecreasing sequence equals its supremum
gaps.quote: Every nondecreasing sequence in $\overline{\mathbb{R}}$ has a limit, and that limit is its supremum.
gaps.note: The page asserts that such a sequence has a limit and that the limit is the supremum, with no argument, so the reader cannot check it from the page.

gaps.quote: Every such set has an infimum and a supremum in $\overline{\mathbb{R}}$.
gaps.note: The page asserts that every set of extended reals has an infimum and a supremum without justification; this needs the completeness of the reals, which the page does not give or explain.
